map.税后工资怎么算？输入应发工资、个人缴纳的五险一金与专项附加扣除，按现行个税累计预: How is take-home pay computed? Enter gross salary, personal social insurance and housing fund, and special additional deductions; the current cumulative-withholding method computes tax payable and net pay.
map.📖 查看「工资税后计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Salary After Tax Calculator Guide"
map.月应纳税所得额 = 应发工资 − 五险一金 − 基本减除费用（5000 元/月）: Monthly taxable income = gross salary − social insurance & housing fund − basic deduction (5,000 CNY/month) − special additional deductions; cumulative taxable income = monthly taxable income × months paid this year; cumulative withholding = cumulative taxable income × withholding rate − quick deduction; current-month withholding = cumulative withholding through this month − cumulative withholding through last month; current-month take-home = gross salary − social insurance & housing fund − current-month withholding
map.按综合所得年度税率表（7 级超额累进）做累计预扣：先把每月收入扣掉五险一金、50: Cumulative withholding under the annual comprehensive-income tax table (7 progressive brackets): deduct social insurance & housing fund, the 5,000 CNY basic deduction and special additional deductions from monthly income, then accumulate tax by the number of months paid this year; current-month tax = cumulative withholding − cumulative withholding through last month. The tool assumes identical income and deductions in months 1–N and excludes year-end bonuses, labor remuneration and annual-settlement refunds or top-ups.

map.月应纳税所得额 = 20000 − 1000 − 500 − 5000 = 13: Monthly taxable income = 20000 − 1000 − 500 − 5000 = 13,500 CNY; 12-month cumulative = 162,000 CNY, in the 20% bracket (quick deduction 16,920), so cumulative withholding = 162,000×20% − 16,920 = 15,480 CNY; cumulative through last month 148,500 CNY corresponds to 148,500×20% − 16,920 = 12,780 CNY, so current-month withholding = 15,480 − 12,780 = 2,700 CNY; current-month take-home = 20,000 − 1,000 − 2,700 = 16,300 CNY; year-to-date take-home = 20,000×12 − 1,000×12 − 15,480 = 212,520 CNY.
map.为什么年初和年末个税不同？: Why does tax differ between early and late in the year?
map.累计预扣法下，累计所得跨入更高税率档后，后期月份的预扣税额会增加，属正常现象。: Under cumulative withholding, once cumulative income crosses into a higher bracket, later months' withholding rises—normal behavior.
map.专项附加扣除有哪些？: What are the special additional deductions?
map.子女教育、赡养老人、住房贷款利息或租金、继续教育、大病医疗、婴幼儿照护等，需据实: Child education, elderly care, housing loan interest or rent, continuing education, critical illness, infant care, etc.; declare them truthfully.
map.月数为什么会影响个税？: Why does the number of months affect the tax?
map.月数是累计预扣的计税期数，不是简单把单月税额乘以月数。工具假设 1–N 月每月收: The number of months is the tax period for cumulative withholding, not a simple multiplier of the monthly tax. The tool assumes identical income and deductions in months 1–N, so cumulative income grows with the month count and may cross brackets; current-month tax equals cumulative withholding through this month minus cumulative withholding through last month.
map.结果和工资条不一致？: Result differs from your pay slip?
map.基数、比例与扣除项因单位与城市而异，且工具默认各月收入相同；请以单位申报与工资条: Bases, ratios and deductions vary by employer and city, and the tool assumes identical monthly income; defer to your employer's filing and pay slip.

map.累计应纳税所得额 = 月应纳税所得额 × 累计已发月数；累计应预扣 = 累计应纳: cumulative taxable = monthly taxable × months paid; cumulative tax = cumulative taxable × rate − quick deduction
map.综合所得年度税率表（7 级超额累进）: Annual comprehensive-income tax table (7 progressive brackets)
map.本月预扣 = 截至本月累计应预扣 − 截至上月累计应预扣: current month = cumulative tax through this month − cumulative tax through last month
map.累计预扣法逐月扣缴口径: Monthly withholding under the cumulative method
map.基本减除费用（免征额）5000 元/月，五险一金与专项附加扣除可税前扣除；两者是: Basic deduction (tax exemption) of 5,000 CNY/month; social insurance & housing fund and special additional deductions are pre-tax deductible. The two are independent items and are never merged.
map.专项附加：子女教育 2000/月、房贷利息 1000/月、房租 800-1500: Special deductions: child education 2,000/month, housing-loan interest 1,000/month, rent 800–1,500/month, etc.
